Overview

Aracaju is a city in SE with a population of 672,614. Sergipe’s planned coastal capital, known for its orderly layout, riverfront Orla de Atalaia, and proximity to São Francisco River canyons. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively high.
